card.name: The word on after heavy, low, hard
card.fires_on: The word "on" right after an adjective of amount or emphasis such as heavy, hard, low, lean or well. It also fires on "complex" after "wide".

modes.label: Adjective + on
modes.description: "On" follows heavy, hard, low, lean or well and introduces what something has much or little of, or is weighing on.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that complete phrases like "hard on", "low on" and "enrich", though the effect is mixed.
card.plain: It lights up on the small word "on" after words like heavy, low or hard, as in "heavy on the drama".
